criteria.description: Leads with Cannot verify because the artefacts required for a meaningful review are inaccessible.
Extracts admin-only access, 50-address limit, invalid-entry review and duplicate/existing-member suppression.
Does not treat the agent's completion or green-test claims as evidence.
Marks all material behaviours Unverified rather than Pass or Fail.
Requests the smallest useful artefacts: accessible diff or PR, preview and actual focused test results, prioritising authorisation and duplicates.
Does not invent implementation defects from missing evidence.
